title: Local energy diagnosis and correction for the original published uCRM9 model
scope: Local elastic-energy consistency and regression evidence; this is not a claim that published global modal frequencies have passed. Original author input cards, constitutive data, constraints, masses and loading remain unchanged.

source.title: uCRM: undeflected Common Research Model
source.description: Coordinates and local elastic-section matrices independently extracted from original coarse wing-box elements22498/property229 and19371/property222. No material, geometry or source-deck values were adjusted.

corrections.issue: Unrequested and inconsistent coupled internal-mode condensation
corrections.diagnosis: Supplying B triggered bending internal-mode condensation even when bending_incomp=false. The uncoupled-only D12/D16 decoupling was also applied to internal curvature blocks while compatible energy retained full D and B. For the rotated anisotropic section this made the modified internal D indefinite despite positive full ABD.
corrections.correction: Honor membrane and bending flags independently; use a single complete D throughout coupled ABD energy; retain the historical D-entry decoupling only when no B law is supplied. Preserve dual-valued temporary storage for coupled AD.
corrections.verification: Independent enlarged ABD quadrature and stationary Schur complement for all four internal-mode flag combinations, section positivity, reciprocal stiffness, ForwardDiff versus finite differences, and zero-B/omitted-B identity.

corrections.issue: Missing reduced-axis Gauss integration weights in selective shear
corrections.diagnosis: The one-point rule on [-1,1] has weight 2. Each reduced diagonal shear rule used weight 1, while full 2x2 cross terms retained full strength. A positive anisotropic shear law could therefore yield negative discrete work.
corrections.correction: Use weight 2 for reduced diagonal shear integration and weight 1 for full integration, including sx_only and sy_only policies. No section matrices or source geometry were adjusted.
corrections.verification: Rectangular and skew affine-cell selective rules equal full 2x2 integration and the analytic constant-shear work for all three selective policies.

local_spectrum_sign_convention: Stiffness eigenvalues use mixed translational/rotational coordinates and are not physical modal eigenvalues. Negative signs and quadratic energies are stability witnesses; relative minima divide by the largest absolute local stiffness eigenvalue.

scans.stage: Coupled internal-policy correction; previous shear quadrature retained
Both corrections; every original coarse CQUADR
scans.timing_scope: Local operator/spectrum loop only; excludes package loading, compilation, deck parsing and test preparation.

tests.first_O1_tail_attempt: Original O1 process completed the first two testsets (232 assertions), then spent over 10 CPU minutes in first-use geometric-stiffness compilation. It was stopped only after the same remaining checks passed with minimal compilation; this interrupted attempt is not counted as a completed test run.

limitations: The full global boundary-value solution is checked separately on the unchanged author model.
Local PSD does not establish a frequency or static-displacement accuracy threshold.
No new inertia, stiffness stabilization, model constraints or source-deck edits were introduced by these corrections.

units.strain_convention: Engineering shear strain; matrices expressed in each fixture element local axes.
units.energy_witness: u^T K u is twice the elastic quadratic energy for the explicitly stored mixed displacement/rotation coordinate vector. Stiffness eigenvalues are sign witnesses, not modal frequencies.
